name: Alphabet Inc.
description: Global technology conglomerate focused on Google Search, YouTube, Android, Google Cloud enterprise services, and moonshot ventures.

name: Salesforce Inc.
description: Provides customer relationship management (CRM) software, cloud enterprise applications for sales, service, marketing, and AI-driven business solutions.

name: Adobe Inc.
description: Offers creative, document, and digital marketing software including Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Acrobat, Firefly generative AI, and Experience Cloud.

name: Intel Corp.
description: Designs and manufactures microprocessors and foundry solutions for client computing, datacenters, and emerging semiconductor architectures.

name: Walmart Inc.
description: World's largest retailer operating omnichannel supercenters, discount stores, warehouse clubs (Sam's Club), and expanding retail media and e-commerce.

name: Amazon.com Inc.
description: Dominant e-commerce platform and cloud provider offering online retail, third-party seller services, advertising, Prime subscriptions, and logistics fulfillment.

name: Target Corp.
description: General merchandise retailer offering curated apparel, beauty, food, and essentials via store-as-hub fulfillment, Drive Up, and Target Circle loyalty.

name: Costco Wholesale
description: Operates membership warehouse clubs delivering high inventory velocity, ultralow markups on bulk groceries, and strong member renewal rates.

name: Home Depot Inc.
description: Largest home improvement specialty retailer in the world serving DIY homeowners and professional contractors across 2,300+ stores.

name: Lowe's Companies
description: Operates home improvement retail stores serving DIY customers and Pro trade accounts with maintenance, repair, and remodeling goods.

name: Dollar General Corp.
description: Operates 20,000+ small-box discount stores serving rural and underserved American communities with value-oriented consumable goods.

name: United Parcel Service
description: Global parcel delivery, supply chain management, and air cargo leader operating an integrated small package ground and air logistics network.

name: FedEx Corp.
description: Provides express transportation, ground small-package delivery, and freight shipping, actively consolidating Express and Ground into ONE FedEx.

name: Expeditors International
description: Non-asset-based global logistics provider specializing in air and ocean freight forwarding, customs brokerage, and purchase order management.

name: C.H. Robinson Worldwide
description: Leading multimodal logistics platform offering truckload brokerage, ocean/air forwarding, and supply chain technology services.

name: XPO Inc.
description: Asset-based less-than-truckload (LTL) carrier in North America with additional European transportation operations, focused on yield management and network density.

name: GXO Logistics
description: World's largest pure-play contract logistics provider managing automated warehousing, reverse logistics, and omnichannel e-commerce fulfillment.

name: J.B. Hunt Transport
description: Leading North American surface transportation provider with high market share in intermodal rail containers, dedicated contract fleets, and final mile delivery.
